scope: one temporal window under joint exchangeability of scored site histories
surrogate: apply one shared Fisher-Yates site permutation to all scored training and test prefixes per draw; preserve complete site histories and frame histograms
pipeline: refit the ordered dictionary and Huffman for every draw, including training admission; compare the admitted pair with its first entry alone on the same held-out frames
statistic: positive part of the pair's charged gain against its first entry alone; a completed draw with no admitted pair contributes zero
rank: count ties with more extreme values; retain signed draw gains and absent pairs; suppress the rank after any failed draw
verification: independent shared-site replay, marginal no-second-entry control, missing inputs, and budget failures
limits: engineering fixtures; joint site exchangeability is required for inference and population calibration remains open
